title: Program delivery
outcomes: a delivery review naming conflicting claims, the critical path, risks with owners, and decisions needed
a status update that says what happened, what did not, and what is decided
inputs: the plan, schedule, or status document
work-tracking and calendar sources the project declares
minimumEvidence: every date, dependency, and capacity claim cites the source it came from; a claim two sources contradict is a conflict, not a fact
escalation: a conflict between commitments is raised to the owner named in the constitution, never resolved by the pack
capacity is stated as a range with assumptions; a throughput figure alone is never capacity
